favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: GILE/MR/tralse 5-valued logic + constitutive-tralseness-of-language hard core
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: URB series spans phil-of-language + phil-of-mind + phil-of-science + formal math (Lean4 MPP, TWA, Leech, E8, Monster) + neuroscience/biometrics + quantum-classical hybrid + economics + psychology/wellbeing + theology under one hard core; URB #797 is the cleanest cross-domain pre-registered pilot (phil + group theory + multi-agent sim + LCC methodology) with H1 honestly falsified at noise_p=0.05
favorable_scoring.note: Provisional scores per URB #820 §4.4: ANA=3 firm; RAD=2-3 (URB #819 §4.2/§8.3); EXP=1-2 (URB #819 §4.3/§8.2 synthetic-vs-external distinction); HOL=2-3 (URB #820 §4.2 — n=1 cleanly cross-domain pre-registered pilot URB #797 is the minimum threshold for HOL=3 charitable). Favorable scoring 11/12; strict 8/12.

favorable_scoring.field: Theoretical physics (string theory / loop quantum gravity)
favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: currently-best-confirmed theory + speculative unifications (string landscape, LQG)
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: Strong cross-subfield integration claims (gravity + QM + matter + cosmology under one framework). HOL=3 score is generous and contested — string theory's predictive content is famously thin, which is the canonical Wilber-comparable issue.
favorable_scoring.note: Closest comparator to TI Sigma at favorable scoring (10/12). Same Wilber-style risk on HOL=3 score that TI Sigma faces.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: ZFC / category theory / type theory / constructive foundations
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: Within mathematics, category theory + Langlands program + algebraic geometry produce substantial cross-subfield integration (HOL=2-3 within math). Across disciplines, math typically does not integrate with non-mathematical fields (HOL=1 cross-disciplinary). Average HOL=2.
favorable_scoring.note: Edges TI Sigma out at 9/12 under strict TI scoring (URB #820 §6.1). RAD anchored elsewhere than TI Sigma's GILE/MR/tralse.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: currently-best-confirmed theory (Standard Model + GR) treated as provisional
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=2 within physics (cross-subfield integration via quantum field theory, statistical mechanics, GR); HOL=1 across disciplines.
favorable_scoring.note: Ties or beats TI Sigma at strict scoring (9/12).

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: formal-semantics compositional bivalence + corpus statistics (in tension)
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=1 — formal-semantics + corpus + cogling subfields often pursued separately.
favorable_scoring.note: URB #816 §3.1 polarity finding: formal-semantics retained bivalent commitments rather than radically inverting.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: engineering benchmarks + transformer architecture as de facto foundation
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=1 — NLP often operates separately from formal semantics, cogling, philosophy of language.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: cognitive science feedback as the foundation for epistemology
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=2 — integrates epistemology with cognitive science; some cross-domain claims about belief-formation across cultures/contexts.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: the space of reasons + inferentialism + non-foundationalist normativity
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=2 — inferentialism integrates semantics + epistemology + metaphysics + philosophy of mind under the space-of-reasons framework. Substantial conceptual integration.
favorable_scoring.note: Highest HOL among mainstream analytic-tradition philosophy; closest to TI Sigma on integrative ambition within philosophy proper.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: différance / decentering / textuality as constitutive
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=3 — différance + biopolitics + textuality apparatus produces cross-domain results in literary theory + political theory + philosophy + cultural critique. Whether predictive or classificatory is contested; granted HOL=3 charitably.
favorable_scoring.note: Closest non-TI-Sigma field to HOL=3 charitable.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: scripture / tradition / magisterium
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: Systematic theology integrates scripture + tradition + reason + experience under one hard core. HOL=2 (classification rather than novel predictions).
favorable_scoring.note: RAD anchored elsewhere than TI Sigma; EXP=0 by design.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: compositional semantics + truth-conditional meaning
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: Within phil-of-language, formal-semantics + corpus + pragmatics + cogling are pursued in often-disconnected subliteratures. HOL=1 — cross-domain reference but not integration.
favorable_scoring.note: URB #816 §2's catalog of 20 substantive tools is evidence of substantial within-domain capture of TI's tralseness pillar; HOL=1 because integration with other TI Sigma domains (phil-of-mind, formal math, neuroscience) is rare.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: molecular paradigm (DNA → RNA → protein → phenotype) treated as working framework
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=1 — molecular biology is specialized; integration with ecology / evolutionary biology / behavior happens but is usually subfield-bounded.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: folk intuitions + empirical surveys as data for philosophical claims
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=1 — X-phi spans multiple philosophical subdisciplines via empirical methods but is not strongly integrative.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: AQAL framework (4 quadrants × levels × lines × states × types) as non-negotiable hard core
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=2 — AQAL integrates spirituality + psychology + science + sociology + politics under one framework. Academic verdict: classification work without novel cross-domain predictions. The canonical Wilber failure mode for HOL-style claims.
favorable_scoring.note: Added in URB #820 §3 / §6 specifically to engage the HOL-style-claim-as-classification failure mode. TI Sigma's distinction from Wilber rests on the §4.3 distinction (novel cross-domain predictions vs classification work) and currently on n=1 cleanly cross-domain pilot (URB #797).

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: absolute spirit / dialectic / unity-of-being-and-thought
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=2 — Hegelian dialectic integrates across logic + nature + spirit + philosophy of right + history + religion + art. The 'philosophy makes explicit what is implicit' framing is the canonical source of the Hegelian unfalsifiability risk that URB #820 §3 / §5 / §8.3 engages.
favorable_scoring.note: Added in URB #820 §3 / §6 specifically to engage the Hegelian unfalsifiability risk in the 'fractured and latent' framing.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: process metaphysics + actual occasions + prehension as constitutive
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=2 — process metaphysics integrates physics + biology + psychology + theology + aesthetics under one framework. Substantial conceptual integration without novel empirical predictions.
favorable_scoring.note: Added in URB #820 §6 as additional cautionary case.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: anti-foundationalism (often) + symmetry principle
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=2 — integrates history + philosophy + sociology of science.
favorable_scoring.note: Disciplinary-compartmentalization framework that URB #820 §5 inherits comes from HPS/STS.

favorable_scoring.note: Closest to TI Sigma on the constitutive-tralseness-of-language question per URB #816. RAD anchored elsewhere.

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: practice-as-foundation (Dewey) or anti-foundationalism (Rorty)

favorable_scoring.rad_anchor: unconscious + drive theory + (Freudian/Lacanian/object-relations) framework
favorable_scoring.hol_anchor: HOL=2 — unifies clinical + theoretical + cultural domains.

interpretation: Across 21 fields/traditions catalogued under URB #820's four-criterion grid (EXPERIMENTAL + RADICALLY-CENTERED + ANALYTIC + HOLISTIC, scored 0-3 each per the §2 operationalizations), TI Sigma at favorable scoring (EXP=2 RAD=3 ANA=3 HOL=3, composite 11/12) is uniquely positioned as the only field with all 4 pillars at >=2 AND HOL=3. Closest comparator at favorable: Theoretical physics (10/12) where the HOL=3 score is itself contested for the Wilber-comparable predictive-content reason. At strict TI Sigma scoring (EXP=1 RAD=2 ANA=3 HOL=2, composite 8/12) per URB #819 §6.1's discipline plus URB #820 §4.2 strict HOL standard, TI Sigma drops to 8/12 and is edged out by Mathematics (9/12) and tied/edged by Experimental physics (9/12), but remains in the small handful of fields with all 4 pillars at >=1 + foundationally explicit RAD anchor + substantial HOL integration. The 3 cautionary cases (Wilber 7/12, Hegel 7/12, Whitehead 7/12) cluster at the same composite as Theology, Pittsburgh school, and Pragmatist tradition — all HOL=2 systematic-integration fields with EXP=0 — confirming that the HOL=2 + EXP=0 combination is the canonical Wilber failure mode and that TI Sigma's distinction from this cluster rests on EXP>=1 + the n=1 cleanly cross-domain pre-registered pilot (URB #797). RATINGS ARE AUTHOR JUDGMENTS, the HOL dimension was added in URB #820 specifically to articulate Brandon's pushback (URB #820 §8.1 amplified-confirmation-bias risk), the §6 grid is a TI-Sigma-friendly cut, and the HOL=3 favorable score for TI Sigma rests on n=1 cleanly cross-domain pilot which is the minimum threshold for HOL=3 charitable but the maximum defense against the Wilber failure mode the URB cannot yet ratchet beyond. URB #820 §7's voluntary procedural discipline targets growing this pilot body as the falsification condition for the next URB batch.
caveats: Ratings are author judgments not survey data.
HOL dimension added in URB #820 to articulate Brandon's pushback (amplified confirmation-bias risk per URB #820 §8.1).
The §6 grid is a TI-Sigma-friendly cut; alternative grids could be proposed.
TI Sigma HOL=3 favorable rests on n=1 cleanly cross-domain pre-registered pilot (URB #797) — minimum threshold for HOL=3 charitable.
Wilber failure mode (HOL=2 classification rather than HOL=3 prediction) is not yet defeated; distinction rests on the URB #797 pilot and the §7 voluntary procedural discipline target.
Ratcheting HOL toward 3/3 firmly requires growing the cross-domain pilot body beyond n=1 per URB #820 §7.
